messages:
maria: heads-up — I'm going to kick off a small experiment: add a deprioritized "economy" lane that routes to a quantized backup model when Dedicated lanes hit CB thresholds. want quick feedback on headers, probe keys, and what we should show in the console.

sam: +1 to the idea. main concern is tenant affinity: we should preserve the original route headers so any downstream filtering still works.

akshay: agree. can we do a short TTL-based probe so the gateway toggles lane off after X consecutive slow responses? e.g., probe window 30s, threshold 5 slow calls.

maria: thinking: gateway will attach header `x-rd-lane:economy` and `x-rd-probe-key:lk_<hex>`; runtime responds with `x-rd-cb-handshake:ok` when it accepts probe. if handshake missing, gateway marks lane degraded.

jay: small nit: prefer `x-rd-lane` values be stable strings (no version numbers). add `x-rd-lane-origin` for route that caused downgrade, helpful for metrics.

olivia: from Console/UX: we need a clear metric set: route_p95, cb_trips, probe_success_rate, avg_token_cost, and a per-route "economy_shift_rate". show last 1h/24h.

sam: + console: add a panel with sample requests that triggered fallback (hash of prompt) so SREs can inspect regressions (privacy-safe).

akshay: minimal YAML sketch for routing policy:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/generate
    priority: primary
    fallback:
      lane: economy
      probe_key_header: x-rd-probe-key
      cb_threshold: 0.2
      probe_window_s: 30
```

maria: looks good. question: should the gateway do rate-limited spillover or immediate reroute when CB fires? i prefer immediate reroute + short quiesce (5s) to avoid large queues.

jay: immediate reroute is safer for latency SLOs. but implement a token-bucket on the economy lane so we don't DDOS cheap pools.

olivia: for dashboarding: show both attempted routed requests and actual accepted by backup model; label them "attempted_fallbacks" vs "accepted_fallbacks". derive acceptance_rate = accepted/attempted.

sam: telemetry signals: p95, p99, cb_open_count, cb_close_count, rejected_per_min, fallback_accept_rate. emit these with tags: tenant, route, lane, model_variant.

maria: good. also add an event stream when handshake fails repeatedly: `economy_lane:probe_failed` with last handshake payload.

deploy-bot: started probe job for lane=economy on cluster=dedicated-us-west at 2026-03-19T15:03:10Z

akshay: testing note — ensure KV cache hits are preserved when switching lanes; otherwise prompts with long prefixes will re-tokenize and blow latency.

maria: yes — gateway should forward cache-key header `x-rd-kv-key` untouched. backup model will check for partial cache and return incremental generation when possible.

olivia: UX request: when we show fallback events in Rollouts UI, surface suggested actions: "increase dedicated capacity", "raise CB threshold", "promote backup model to dedicated lane"

jay: one more operational: when fallback activated, send a low-priority alert to #oncall and high-priority to the tenant-owner if SLA risk crosses threshold.

sam: can we create a small eval set to auto-run on accepted_fallbacks to detect quality regressions? if quality drops by X, auto-unroll the economy lane.

maria: yes, add a regression-alert pipeline. default: if BLEU/embedding-sim drops >5% on sampled accepted_fallbacks for >10 mins, mark lane quarantined.

akshay: implementation detail: CB hook will need to surface which rule tripped (latency vs error vs quota). include `x-rd-cb-reason` on gateway logs.

maria: action items:
- akshay: add YAML schema and CB hook, preserve KV header. (owner)
- jay: token-bucket + rate limits for economy lane. (owner)
- olivia: console panels + rollout action buttons + suggested actions. (owner)
- sam: sampling eval pipeline + telemetry tags. (owner)

maria: I'll run the experiment on a subset of traffic for 12h starting in 30m. ping me if you want in.

olivia: thanks — will add dashboard placeholders and a quick explainer for support.

deploy-bot: probe job completed: lane=economy cluster=dedicated-us-west status=ok probes=120 success_rate=0.98 duration_s=4320

sam: initial look — p95 on primary rose slightly but fallbacks kept tail within SLO. pushing more telemetry to metrics team.

maria: cool — will keep thread updated. if anything obvious pops up, escalate.

jay: thumbs up :thumbsup:
